proposedFix: Not a defect. To make this cell testable, org config (NOT a pricing-procedure change) would be required: (a) create an Evergreen ProductSellingModelOption mapping a SaaS product to one of the 4 existing Evergreen ProductSellingModels, (b) create an active Evergreen PricebookEntry on 'Fortra Price Book' with a non-zero GBP list, then (c) build a renewal quote (QuoteAction Type='Renew') with that Evergreen line off a source Asset carrying a positive net, and force-reprice. Because step (a)/(b) are org-config a real rep cannot do today, and any Apex-inserted fresh Evergreen line would also be subject to the documented headless base-seed $0-net gap, the cell stays BLOCKED until Evergreen is genuinely productized in the org.
notes: Evergreen is defined-but-unproductized in FortraUAT: 4 Evergreen ProductSellingModels exist as orphans with 0 PSMO, 0 PBE, 0 lines across ~1.2M QLIs. Sibling P1 rows B-04 (Evergreen-new full-period) and B-05 (Evergreen anytime proration) were NOT produced (no rows/B-04.json or B-05.json) -> the entire Evergreen family is un-smoke-testable for the same root cause, not just the renewal cell. The renewal carry-forward path this scenario would exercise is the SC-3350/SC-3346 COLA/Derived renewal-net family, whose NetUnitPrice commit is independently documented as fragile/inert for non-derived lines (memory project_cola_renewal_pricing_review / project_sc3346_rncola_commit_fix) -> even with Evergreen data, a fresh headless Apex-inserted Evergreen renewal would most likely net $0 spuriously (base-seed gap) and remain BLOCKED rather than FAIL. defect_provenance=none/completeness-gap as cataloged.
verdict_reason: No Evergreen data and no UI-valid path to create it (0 Evergreen PSMO/PBE/lines org-wide), so the Evergreen x Renewal cell cannot be smoke-tested on real data; preflight cannot pass -> BLOCKED, not FAIL, with the proc trace confirming V21 would handle it correctly if data existed.
